sf2-reviva.desc: Places a blessing on one ally so that they come back to life on the spot if they fall.
sf2-reviva.note: Beast Arts. A combination art of Beast + Fire (the command is Beast, Beast, Fire, Fire).

sf2-berserk.desc: Turns one ally into a berserker to draw out their power. They can no longer be controlled.
sf2-berserk.note: Beast Arts. A combination art made of Beast alone (the command is Beast, Beast, Beast).

sf2-seimeiryoku-kyouka.desc: Boosts one ally's life force so they recover HP every turn.
sf2-seimeiryoku-kyouka.note: Beast Arts. A combination art made of Beast alone (the command is Beast, Beast).

sf2-ju.desc: Attacks one enemy with the Tree anima and raises the user's Psycho.
sf2-ju.note: The basic art of Tree Arts. Used with items that hold the Tree anima (such as Kurosuburanchi).

sf2-ishi.desc: Lowers one enemy's Defence with the Stone anima.
sf2-ishi.note: The basic art of Stone Arts. Used with items that hold the Stone anima (such as Rokkuhāto).

sf2-honoo.desc: Burns one enemy with the Fire anima.
sf2-honoo.note: The basic art of Fire Arts. Used with items that hold the Fire anima (such as the Kaseigan no Udekazari bracelet).

sf2-mizu.desc: Restores one ally's HP with the Water anima.
sf2-mizu.note: The basic art of Water Arts. Used with items that hold the Water anima (such as Burūwōtā).

sf2-oto.desc: Attacks one enemy with the Sound anima and lowers its Psycho.
sf2-oto.note: The basic art of Sound Arts. Used with items that hold the Sound anima (such as the Ginkan no Tsue staff).

sf2-kemono.desc: Raises one ally's Morale with the Beast anima.
sf2-kemono.note: The basic art of Beast Arts. Used with items that hold the Beast anima (such as the Jūkaku no Goin charm). For the cost, JP 1 from SaGa Frontier2wiki was adopted (RRPG says 2).

sf2-jukishou.desc: Strikes one enemy with a palm infused with Tree ki, and raises the user's Psycho.
sf2-jukishou.note: A Tree art technique used in unarmed combat. Used with Shirumāru's exclusive equipment, Shirumāru Rion.

sf2-juretsugiri.desc: Slashes one enemy with a sword infused with the Tree anima, and raises the user's Psycho.
sf2-juretsugiri.note: A Tree art technique (sword). Used with swords that hold the Tree anima (such as a wooden sword).

sf2-juda.desc: Strikes one enemy with a staff infused with the Tree anima, and raises the user's Psycho.
sf2-juda.note: A Tree art technique (staff). Used with items such as the Wakagi no Tsue.

sf2-midori-no-kiba.desc: Thrusts at one enemy with a spear infused with the Tree anima, and raises the user's Psycho.
sf2-midori-no-kiba.note: A Tree art technique (spear). Used with items such as a wooden spear.

sf2-jumoku-no-ya.desc: Shoots one enemy with an arrow infused with the Tree anima, and raises the user's Psycho.
sf2-jumoku-no-ya.note: A Tree art technique (bow). Used with items such as the Renjā Bō.

sf2-needle-burst.desc: Bursts countless needles to slash through one enemy.
sf2-needle-burst.note: A unique art used with a weapon holding the Tree and Stone animas (the Akumasō no Kiba). Damage element: slash.

sf2-ishi-no-kobushi.desc: Strikes one enemy with a fist infused with the power of stone, lowering its Defence.
sf2-ishi-no-kobushi.note: A Stone art technique used in unarmed combat. Used with Shirumāru's exclusive equipment, Shirumāru Rion.

sf2-ishi-no-tsurugi.desc: Slashes one enemy with a sword infused with the Stone anima, lowering its Defence.
sf2-ishi-no-tsurugi.note: A Stone art technique (sword). Used with items such as the Sutōn Naifu.

sf2-sekifudan.desc: Cleaves one enemy with an axe infused with the Stone anima, lowering its Defence.
sf2-sekifudan.note: A Stone art technique (axe). Used with items such as a stone axe.

sf2-sekigeki.desc: Strikes one enemy with a staff infused with the Stone anima, lowering its Defence.
sf2-sekigeki.note: A Stone art technique (staff). Used with items such as the Saryū no Tsue.

sf2-ishizuki.desc: Thrusts at one enemy with a spear infused with the Stone anima, lowering its Defence.
sf2-ishizuki.note: A Stone art technique (spear). Used with items such as the Kongōseki no Yari.

sf2-honoo-no-tachi.desc: Slashes one enemy with a sword wreathed in flame.
sf2-honoo-no-tachi.note: A Fire art technique (sword). Used with items such as the Honoo no Roddo.

sf2-honoo-de-mapputatsu.desc: Smashes one enemy in two with an axe wreathed in flame.
sf2-honoo-de-mapputatsu.note: A Fire art technique (axe). Used with items such as the Furinto Akusu.

sf2-karyuu.desc: Thrusts at one enemy with a spear wreathed in flame.
sf2-karyuu.note: A Fire art technique (spear). Used with items such as the Akari no Yari.

sf2-hiya.desc: Shoots one enemy with a burning arrow.
sf2-hiya.note: A Fire art technique (bow). Used with items such as the Karyūdo no Yumi.

sf2-ansatsujutsu-hebi.desc: Attacks one enemy with a poisoned blow and poisons it. Very effective against frog enemies.
sf2-ansatsujutsu-hebi.note: A unique art used with equipment holding the Water anima (the Sasori no Dokubari).

sf2-onpaken.desc: Slashes one enemy with a sword charged with sound waves, lowering its Psycho.
sf2-onpaken.note: A Sound art technique (sword). Used with items such as the Sukurīmā.

sf2-onpageki.desc: Strikes one enemy with a staff charged with sound waves, lowering its Psycho.
sf2-onpageki.note: A Sound art technique (staff). Used with items such as the Ginkan no Tsue.

sf2-onpadan.desc: Shoots one enemy with an arrow of sound waves, lowering its Psycho.
sf2-onpadan.note: A Sound art technique (bow). Used with items such as the Seigen no Yumi.

iceja.note: Learned by Marle and Magus. Magus's version is more powerful. The element is Water (some sources wrongly list Magus's version as Light).

chrono-shining.desc: Deals massive Light-element damage to all enemies.
chrono-shining.note: Learned by Crono. The in-game element is "Heaven" (天), which this site calls Light.

chrono-heal.desc: Restores a little HP to all allies.

chrono-haste.desc: Raises the action speed of one ally.

chrono-arise.desc: Revives one knocked-out ally and fully restores their HP.
chrono-arise.note: Learned by Marle. It is a different character's technique from Crono's Reizu, so the two are not treated as steps in the same line.

chrono-protect.desc: Casts Protect on one ally, reducing the damage they take.

chrono-flare.desc: Deals massive Fire-element damage to all enemies.

chrono-water.desc: Deals Water-element damage to one enemy.

chrono-waterga.desc: Deals Water-element damage to all enemies.

chrono-darkbomb.desc: A Darkness-element explosion that damages a circular area around the targeted enemy.
chrono-darkbomb.note: Learned by Magus. The area is a circle (centered on the enemy).

chrono-magicbarrier.desc: Gives one ally defense against magic.

chrono-darkmist.desc: Deals Darkness-element damage to all enemies.

chrono-blackhole.desc: May wipe out the enemies in a surrounding circle in a single blow.
chrono-blackhole.note: Learned by Magus. The area is a circle (centered on the caster).

chrono-darkmatter.desc: Deals heavy Darkness-element damage to all enemies.

dalto.note: Mage spell, level 4 (DALTO). The element is cold.

madalto.note: Mage spell, level 5 (MADALTO). The element is cold.

halito.note: Mage spell, level 1 (HALITO). The element is fire.

mahalito.note: Mage spell, level 3 (MAHALITO). The element is fire.

lahalito.note: Mage spell, level 4 (LAHALITO). The element is fire.

dios.note: Priest spell, level 1 (DIOS). Can also be used in camp.

katino.note: Mage spell, level 1 (KATINO). Direct attacks against a sleeping enemy deal extra damage.

badi.note: Priest spell, level 5 (BADI). Some enemies, such as the undead, are immune.

di.note: Priest spell, level 5 (DI). Usable only in camp, success is not guaranteed, and a character who has turned to ashes cannot be brought back.

kadorto.note: Priest spell, level 7 (KADORTO). It can revive even from the ashes state and fully restores HP, but a failure risks turning the target to ashes or losing them for good.

wiz-mogref.desc: Hardens the caster's body to improve their AC (defense).

wiz-dumapic.desc: Reveals the party's current position in the labyrinth.
wiz-dumapic.note: Mage spell, level 1 (DUMAPIC). Used in camp.

wiz-dilto.desc: Wraps a group of enemies in darkness, worsening their AC so they are easier to hit.

wiz-sopic.desc: Makes the caster's body transparent, improving their AC.

wiz-molito.desc: Attacks a group of enemies with a storm of sparks.
wiz-molito.note: Mage spell, level 3 (MOLITO). The sources do not state an element.

wiz-morlis.desc: Instills fear in a group of enemies, greatly worsening their AC.

wiz-mamorlis.desc: Extends the effect of Mōrisu to all enemies.

wiz-makanito.desc: Instantly kills low-level enemies all at once.
wiz-makanito.note: Mage spell, level 5 (MAKANITO). The upper limit on the enemy level it affects differs by source: "level 7 or lower" or "level 8 or lower." It does not work on the undead.

wiz-lakanito.desc: Steals the air around a group of enemies, suffocating them to death.

wiz-zilwan.note: Mage spell, level 6 (ZILWAN). Works only on the undead.

wiz-masopic.desc: Makes the whole party transparent, improving their AC.
wiz-masopic.note: Mage spell, level 6 (MASOPIC). Some sources write it as "マソピック."

wiz-haman.desc: At the cost of one of the caster's levels, causes one of several miracles.
wiz-haman.note: Mage spell, level 6 (HAMAN). The caster needs a certain minimum level to use it. Whether you can choose the effect differs by version (the APPLE version #1 does not allow a choice).

wiz-malor.desc: Teleports the whole party to a chosen point in the labyrinth.
wiz-malor.note: Mage spell, level 7 (MALOR). If used in battle, the destination is random. Some versions write it as "マラー."

wiz-mahaman.desc: A higher-tier spell that causes a miracle chosen from more candidates than Haman.
wiz-mahaman.note: Mage spell, level 7 (MAHAMAN). Like Haman, it lowers the caster's level by one.

wiz-tiltowait.desc: The strongest attack spell, attacking all enemies with a huge, nuclear-like explosion.
wiz-tiltowait.note: Mage spell, level 7 (TILTOWAIT). The sources do not state an element. The damage cap was increased in the FC version.

wiz-kalki.desc: Blesses the whole party, slightly improving their AC.

wiz-badios.desc: Damages one enemy with words of a curse.
wiz-badios.note: Priest spell, level 1 (BADIOS). The attack counterpart of the healing spell Diosu. The sources do not state an element.

wiz-milwa.desc: Lights the way with magic light, letting the party see ahead in the labyrinth and see secret doors.
wiz-milwa.note: Priest spell, level 1 (MILWA). The effect wears off after a set number of steps.

wiz-porfic.desc: Raises a magic barrier in front of the caster, improving their AC.

wiz-matu.desc: Blesses the whole party, improving their AC.

wiz-calfo.desc: Identifies the type of trap set on a treasure chest with high probability.

wiz-manifo.desc: Stiffens the bodies of a group of enemies so they cannot act.
wiz-manifo.note: Priest spell, level 2 (MANIFO). Sources describe it in different words, such as "solidify," "freeze" or "paralyze."

wiz-montino.desc: Wraps a group of enemies in silence so they cannot cast spells.

wiz-lomilwa.desc: An advanced version of Miruwa, with the same light effect lasting much longer.

wiz-dialko.desc: Cures one ally's paralysis (and, in some sources, sleep).

wiz-latumapic.desc: Reveals the names of enemies whose identity is unknown.
wiz-latumapic.note: Priest spell, level 3 (LATUMAPIC). This is the FC version's spelling. Other versions also write it as "ラテュマピック." In the APPLE version #1, it must be recast every battle.

wiz-bamatu.desc: Improves the whole party's AC more than Matsu.

wiz-badial.desc: Damages one enemy with a curse stronger than Badiosu.

wiz-latumofis.note: Priest spell, level 4 (LATUMOFIS). Other versions also write it as "ラテュモフィス."

wiz-maporfic.desc: Maintains a magic shield that improves the whole party's AC until they return to the castle.
wiz-maporfic.note: Priest spell, level 4 (MAPORFIC). It can also be cast in camp.

wiz-badialma.desc: Damages one enemy with an even stronger curse.

wiz-litokan.desc: Burns a group of enemies with a pillar of fire.
wiz-litokan.note: Priest spell, level 5 (LITOKAN). The only fire attack spell among the priest spells.

wiz-kandi.desc: Reveals the location of a missing party member (or their body) in the labyrinth.
wiz-kandi.note: Priest spell, level 5 (KANDI). Used in camp.

wiz-lorto.desc: Conjures sharp blades to slice through a group of enemies.
wiz-lorto.note: Priest spell, level 6 (LORTO). The sources do not state an element.

wiz-madi.desc: Fully restores one ally's HP and cures all conditions except death and ashes.

wiz-mabadi.desc: Cuts one enemy's HP down until only a tiny amount remains.
wiz-mabadi.note: Priest spell, level 6 (MABADI). A special attack that leaves only about 1 to 8 HP.

wiz-loktofeit.desc: Teleports the whole party to the castle, escaping the labyrinth.
wiz-loktofeit.note: Priest spell, level 6 (LOKTOFEIT). As the price, most of the party's equipment and money is lost.

wiz-malikto.desc: The strongest priest attack spell, dealing heavy damage to all enemies.
wiz-malikto.note: Priest spell, level 7 (MALIKTO). Some commentary calls it holy power, but the sources do not state an element.

bof-padamu.desc: Deals Fire damage to one enemy.

bof-padama.desc: Attacks one enemy with fire stronger than Padamu.

bof-padamema.desc: Attacks one enemy with even stronger fire.

bof-paenda.desc: The strongest single-target attack of the fire line.

bof-baru.desc: Deals Lightning damage to one enemy.

bof-barura.desc: Attacks one enemy with lightning stronger than Baru.

bof-babaru.desc: Attacks all enemies with lightning stronger than Barurai.

bof-baruhara.desc: The strongest single-target attack of the lightning line.

bof-rei.desc: Deals Ice damage to one enemy.

bof-reiga.desc: Attacks one enemy with ice stronger than Rei.

bof-reigiru.desc: Attacks all enemies with ice stronger than Sūrei.

bof-greigoru.desc: The strongest single-target attack of the ice line.

bof-bure.desc: Attacks all enemies with the power of earth.

bof-bureda.desc: Attacks all enemies with earth power stronger than Būre.

bof-gadabureda.desc: The strongest attack on all enemies in the earth line.

bof-mega.desc: Deals explosion damage to one enemy.
bof-mega.note: RRPG lists it as the "explosion element." The other source does not state an element.

bof-maga.desc: Attacks all enemies with an explosion.
bof-maga.note: The AP cost differs by source, 8 or 11. Hyōri Ittai and Game Kōryaku Site say 11, while RRPG says 8, and the cost field uses 11.

bof-memaga.desc: Attacks one enemy with an explosion stronger than Mega.

bof-megiga.desc: Attacks all enemies with a powerful explosion.

bof-domega.desc: The strongest single-target attack of the explosion line.

bof-soru.desc: Deals enormous damage to all enemies.
bof-soru.note: RRPG lists it as the "special element."

bof-desupu.desc: Deals heavy damage to a single undead enemy only.
bof-desupu.note: Undead only. The Holy element comes from RRPG's description.

bof-hadesu.desc: An undead-only attack stronger than Desupu.

bof-zohadesu.note: Undead only. The AP cost and power differ by source. For the AP cost, Hyōri Ittai and Game Kōryaku Site say 35 and RRPG says 46, and the cost field uses 35.

bof-marekuta.desc: Drains one enemy's AP (the points that magic costs).

bof-ririfu.desc: Restores a little of one ally's HP.

bof-rifuraru.desc: Greatly restores the HP of all allies.

bof-yakuri.desc: Cures the status ailments of one ally.

bof-ribaru.desc: Revives one knocked-out ally with 1 HP.

bof-ribarura.desc: Revives one knocked-out ally with full HP.

bof-tonoro.desc: Lowers the speed of one enemy.

bof-gigan.desc: Raises the attack power of one ally.

bof-katekuto.desc: Raises the defense of one ally.

bof-mikatekuto.desc: Raises the defense of all allies.

bof-hasato.desc: Raises the speed of one ally.

bof-purarak.desc: Raises the luck of one ally.

bof-makato.desc: Reduces the damage one ally takes from magic.

bof-mainama.desc: Places a ward on one ally that blocks enemy magic once.

bof-katomana.desc: Places a ward on one ally that reflects magic.

bof-hyuru.desc: Moves the party to a town it has visited.

bof-esukape.note: RRPG says "always escapes from regular battles."

bof-iwashi.desc: Deals small damage to all enemies with a school of sardines.
bof-iwashi.note: Manillo only. Usable only in battles on the seabed and at the undersea volcano. Sources list its element as "?".

bof-iwashitaigun.desc: Attacks all enemies with a bigger school of sardines than Iwashi.
bof-iwashitaigun.note: Manillo only. Usable only in battles on the seabed and at the undersea volcano. Sources list its element as "?".

bof-katsuo.desc: Deals moderate damage to all enemies with bonito.
bof-katsuo.note: Manillo only. Usable only in battles on the seabed and at the undersea volcano. Sources list its element as "?".

bof-katsuotaigun.desc: Deals heavy damage to all enemies with a huge school of bonito.
bof-katsuotaigun.note: Manillo only. Usable only in battles on the seabed and at the undersea volcano. Sources list its element as "?".

bof2-sheza.desc: Attacks one enemy with a blade of wind.

bof2-sengiri.desc: Slices one enemy to pieces, dealing damage that ignores defense.
bof2-sengiri.note: Learned at the Yamaneko-tei event by choosing one party member to teach (limited time). RRPG classifies it as a "special ability" (特能), not a spell. The Game Kōryaku Site and the English-version guide include it in their spell lists.

bof2-kirie.desc: Wipes out undead enemies all at once.
bof2-kirie.note: Works only on the undead. It replaces the Desupu line (undead-only attacks) of the previous game.

bof2-dobunbara.desc: Halves the HP of every enemy.
bof2-dobunbara.note: Learned at the Namanda Temple bell-ringing event by choosing one party member to teach (limited time). Does not work on bosses. RRPG classifies it as a "special ability" (特能), while the Game Kōryaku Site, the English-version guide and Murui no Gēmu-zuki (a guide article) treat it as a spell.

bof2-rifuresuto.desc: Fully restores the HP of all allies.

bof2-yakurifu.desc: Cures all the status ailments of one ally at once.

bof2-gigato.desc: Greatly raises the attack power of one ally.

bof2-paria.desc: Reduces the magic damage one ally takes.

bof2-sutoru.desc: Lowers the attack power of one enemy.

bof2-deiru.desc: Lowers the defense of one enemy.
bof2-deiru.note: The spelling "デイル" from RRPG and the special-ability summary site was adopted. The Game Kōryaku Site writes it as "ディル."

bof2-daru.desc: Lowers the speed (action power) of one enemy.

bof2-pepopa.note: The AP cost is 5 according to the Game Kōryaku Site, the special-ability summary site and the English-version guide, and 4 according to RRPG. The cost field uses 5.

bof2-hitoyasumi.desc: Advances time to switch between day and night.
bof2-hitoyasumi.note: RRPG classifies it as a "special ability" (特能), not a spell. The Game Kōryaku Site and the English-version guide include it in their spell lists.

bof3-padorama.desc: Attacks all enemies with fire stronger than Padāma.
bof3-padorama.note: The spelling changed from "パドラーム" in the previous game. It can also be learned as a skill from the master Deis (according to RRPG's skill-learning page).

bof3-mekomu.desc: Attacks all enemies with non-elemental power.

bof3-terabureiku.desc: Deals heavy damage to one enemy. Can be used only once per fixed stretch of real time.
bof3-terabureiku.note: It cannot be used again until 5 hours have passed since its last use (per RRPG). The sources do not state an element.

bof3-honoonoyari.desc: Attacks one enemy with a spear of fire.
bof3-honoonoyari.note: Garland only (Gārando). It appears in the spell lists of RRPG and Game Daihōko.

bof3-faiaburesu.desc: Attacks all enemies with a breath of fire. The more HP the caster has left, the stronger it is.

bof3-aisuburesu.desc: Attacks all enemies with a cold breath. The more HP the caster has left, the stronger it is.

bof3-diru.desc: Lowers the defense of one enemy.
bof3-diru.note: The counterpart of Deiru from the previous game. All the sources for this game spell it "ディル."

bof3-pouan.note: The target is listed as one enemy by RRPG and all enemies by Game Daihōko. The scope field uses single target.

bof3-shikibetsu.desc: Examines one enemy's weaknesses, items and more.

bof3-uranai.desc: Foretells the outcome of the battle.

bof3-dokuburesu.desc: Poisons all enemies with a poisonous breath.

bof3-suitoburesu.desc: Puts all enemies to sleep with a sweet breath.

bof3-pamu.desc: Attacks one enemy with a small flame.
bof3-pamu.note: Not learned by leveling. A skill learned through observation (見切り) from Meijigumi, Gumidain and similar monsters. Its name has the same form as the Padamu line. The AP cost and element are confirmed in only one source, RRPG's skill page.

bof3-yapurifu.desc: Restores one ally's HP and cures status ailments.
bof3-yapurifu.note: A skill learned through observation (見切り) from the Drake Knight. Its name is a blend of Apurifu and Yakurifu. The AP cost and effect are confirmed in only one source, RRPG's skill page.

bof3-takurema.note: A skill learned through observation (見切り) from the Rikabātanku. Its name is Marekuta, the AP-draining spell, spelled backward.

bof4-shiza.desc: Deals small Wind damage to one enemy.

bof4-burei.desc: Deals small Earth damage to all enemies.

bof4-buka.desc: Lowers the intelligence of one enemy.
bof4-buka.note: Kōryaku Daihōko and Sakuhin Database write it "ブーカ," while Kōryaku wa Koko! writes "プーカ."

bof4-rikou.desc: Raises the intelligence of one ally.

bof5-guranpadamu.desc: Places a magic circle on the ground that deals Fire damage to enemies who step on it and stops them in their tracks.
bof5-guranpadamu.note: Magic circle (placed type). An English-language source gives its element as magic and describes it as a wall that blocks movement.

bof5-guranpadoramu.desc: Places a powerful fire magic circle that deals heavy damage to enemies who step on it and stops them in their tracks.
bof5-guranpadoramu.note: The Japanese spelling is confirmed in only one source (the move's existence and effect were cross-checked against an English-language source). Magic circle (placed type). Skill Lv 3.

bof5-guranreigiru.desc: Places an ice magic circle that damages enemies who step on it and stops them in their tracks.
bof5-guranreigiru.note: The Japanese spelling is confirmed in only one source (the move's existence and effect were cross-checked against an English-language source). Magic circle (placed type). Skill Lv 2.

bof5-baruboru.desc: Places a lightning magic circle that damages enemies who touch it and shocks them.

bof5-bamuboru.desc: Places a fire magic circle that damages enemies who touch it and knocks them unconscious.
bof5-bamuboru.note: The Japanese spelling is confirmed in only one source (the move's existence and effect were cross-checked against an English-language source). Magic circle (placed type).

bof5-reguboru.desc: Places an ice magic circle that damages enemies who touch it and freezes them.

bof5-ragubaruhara.desc: Places a magic circle and, a few turns later, drops lightning on that spot.
bof5-ragubaruhara.note: The Japanese spelling is confirmed in only one source (the move's existence and effect were cross-checked against an English-language source). Magic circle (placed type). It takes time to activate.

bof5-mirajubakudan.desc: Sets down a doll in Nina's likeness to lure enemies, then detonates it to deal Fire damage.
bof5-mirajubakudan.note: The Japanese spelling is confirmed in only one source (the move's existence and effect were cross-checked against an English-language source). Magic circle (placed type).

bof5-mirajudaibakudan.desc: Sets down a doll in Nina's likeness to lure enemies, then deals heavy damage with a huge explosion.
bof5-mirajudaibakudan.note: The Japanese spelling is confirmed in only one source (the move's existence and effect were cross-checked against an English-language source). Magic circle (placed type). An English-language source gives its element as magic.

bof5-shezafu.desc: Blows away the surrounding enemies over a wide area.
bof5-shezafu.note: The element column in Gin no Ishi is blank.

bof5-puka.desc: Lowers the magic power of one enemy.
bof5-puka.note: The counterpart of Būka (written "プーカ" in some sources) from BoF4.

bof5-bain.desc: Lowers the movement of one enemy.
bof5-bain.note: The Japanese spelling is confirmed in only one source (the move's existence and effect were cross-checked against an English-language source).

bof5-terepoteshon.desc: Swaps positions with a party member.

momo-funyara.desc: Lowers the defense of all enemies.

momo-minafunyara.desc: Lowers the defense of everyone, enemies and allies alike.

momo-tomadoi.desc: Lowers the speed of all enemies.

momo-harahoro.desc: Puts everyone to sleep, enemies and allies alike.

momo-fuin.desc: Seals the arts of all enemies.

momo-madoromi.desc: Seals the enemy's arts and special attacks.
momo-madoromi.note: Sources differ on the target: one enemy or all enemies.

momo-kagenui.desc: Immobilizes everyone but the caster, enemies and allies alike, for a while.

momo-mafuji.desc: Halves the effect of attack arts on the whole party.

momo-mayoke.desc: Protects the whole party from curses during battle.

momo-wazayose.desc: Steals a few technique points from one enemy.

momo-karisome.desc: Creates a weaker double of the caster.
momo-karisome.note: On kouryaku.red, it costs 51/256 of the maximum technique points.

momo-ayakashi.desc: Changes the weather in battle to whatever you like.

momo-hien.desc: Flies to a village already visited.
momo-hien.note: In the game it is called things like "Hien no jutsu."

momo-nukedashi.desc: Escapes from a cave in an instant.

momo-oniyoke.desc: For a while, enemies you have already defeated stop appearing.
momo-oniyoke.note: Some sources write it "おによけ." The cost and users are confirmed in only one source.

momo-fuyu.desc: Floats in the air, taking no damage from poison swamps and the like.

momo-barafubuki.desc: Usable only when HP is 10% of the maximum or less. Deals heavy damage to all enemies.
momo-barafubuki.note: Learned by Ashura. The name contains "吹雪" (blizzard), but the sources do not state an element.

momo-nindo.desc: Reduces the caster's HP and technique points to 1 in exchange for dealing a critical hit to all enemies.
momo-nindo.note: Learned by Ashura. Costs 30% of the technique points. The reading could not be confirmed in sources. The cost is listed as 30% of technique points by newmomotaro and 0 by kouryaku.red.

momo-nagareboshi.desc: Deals a critical hit to all enemies. Its power depends on the caster's defense.
momo-nagareboshi.note: Learned by Princess Yasha. Costs 30% of the technique points. On kouryaku.red, it costs 76/256 of the maximum technique points.

momo-bundori.desc: Deals small damage to all enemies and steals their money at the same time.
momo-bundori.note: Learned by the God of Poverty.

momo-nekosogi.desc: A strengthened Bundori that deals more damage and steals more money.
momo-nekosogi.note: Learned by the God of Poverty.

momo-shiridashi.desc: Deals heavy damage to all enemies.

momo-mahoroba.desc: Restores a random amount of HP to the whole party.
momo-mahoroba.note: Learned by Ashura. The amount restored varies between 1 and 100.

momo-morodashi.desc: Lowers the attack power, defense and speed of all enemies and applies a healing effect to allies.
momo-morodashi.note: Learned by Haradashi. newmomotaro classifies it as a healing art.

momo-baragakure.desc: Makes the caster immune to attacks for a while, but they cannot act in the meantime.

momo-utsuroi.desc: Forces a one-on-one fight with an enemy.

momo-tsumabiki.desc: Lets the caster attack consecutively for a few turns.
momo-tsumabiki.note: Learned by Ashura. The effect lasts 3 to 4 turns.

momo-utakata.desc: Restarts the battle from the first turn.

momo-marudashi.desc: Lets you peek into the women's bath, a gag art.
momo-marudashi.note: Learned by Haradashi. Costs 60 technique points. newmomotaro classifies it under "other arts." Confirmed in only one source (it does not appear on kouryaku.red). The cost and users are confirmed in only one source.

heracles-ban.desc: Attacks one enemy with a ball of fire.
heracles-ban.note: The name of the temple where it is learned differs by source: "Old Temple" or "Mysterious Temple."

heracles-bangar.desc: Attacks one row of enemies with a ball of fire.

heracles-bangarumu.desc: Attacks all enemies with a ball of fire.

heracles-aqua.desc: Attacks one enemy with a jet of water.

heracles-aquaru.desc: Attacks one row of enemies with a jet of water.

heracles-aquarumu.desc: Attacks all enemies with a jet of water.

heracles-hydroa.desc: Unleashes a water attack stronger than Akua on one enemy.

heracles-raiza.desc: Calls a thundercloud and drops lightning on one enemy.

heracles-raiban.desc: Calls a thundercloud and drops lightning on one row of enemies.

heracles-randon.note: RRPG describes it as "Earth element" and RPG Data Library as "high-temperature flames," so the sources do not agree on its element.

heracles-kuesu.desc: Drops a beam of light to attack one enemy.

heracles-kueisu.desc: Drops a beam of light to attack one row of enemies.

heracles-kueisara.desc: Drops a beam of light to attack all enemies.

heracles-herion.desc: Deals heavy damage to one enemy with holy light.
heracles-herion.note: Both of the two sources consulted write it as "へリオン" (with a hiragana-looking first character).

heracles-pautesuma.desc: Fully restores the HP of all allies.

heracles-irumeku.desc: Gets one knocked-out ally back on their feet with half HP.

heracles-irumoa.desc: Gets one knocked-out ally back on their feet with full HP.

heracles-emuwaru.desc: Shares the caster's MP with allies.
heracles-emuwaru.note: The target differs by source: "a single ally" or "all allies."

heracles-takusuton.desc: Gives the caster's HP, MP and abilities to one ally.

heracles-torero.note: The MP cost is 3 in RRPG and 7 in RPG Data Library, and the cost field uses RRPG's value.

heracles-goheru.desc: Swaps the HP and MP of all enemies.

heracles-de-supara.desc: Lowers the strength (attack power) of one enemy.

heracles-de-garudo.desc: Lowers the defense of one enemy.

heracles-de-supimu.desc: Lowers the speed of one row of enemies.

heracles-supara.desc: Raises the strength (attack power) of one ally.

heracles-garudo.desc: Raises the defense of one ally.

heracles-garuda.desc: Raises the defense of all allies.

heracles-supimu.desc: Raises the speed of all allies.

heracles-into.desc: Raises the intelligence of one ally.

heracles-interu.desc: Raises the intelligence of all allies.

heracles-ri-aqua.desc: Protects all allies from some attack magic, such as the water line.

heracles-ri-kuesu.desc: Protects all allies from light and lightning attack magic.

heracles-ri-ora.desc: Protects all allies from attack magic in general.

heracles-rokkubai.desc: Protects one ally from every kind of attack, but they cannot act in the meantime.

heracles-noarun.desc: Instantly moves to a town you have visited.

heracles-rakushion.desc: Lowers the chance of encountering enemies.

daikaiju-ban.desc: Attacks one enemy with the power of fire.

daikaiju-banga.desc: Attacks one enemy with fire stronger than Ban.

daikaiju-babanga.desc: Attacks one enemy with even stronger fire.

daikaiju-gigabanga.desc: Attacks all enemies with powerful fire.

daikaiju-mega.desc: Attacks all enemies with the power of fire.

daikaiju-megato.desc: Attacks all enemies with fire stronger than Mega.

daikaiju-megadesu.desc: Attacks all enemies with even stronger fire.

daikaiju-megaban.note: The target differs by source: "a single target plus its surroundings" or "all enemies."

daikaiju-hado.desc: Attacks one enemy with the power of water.

daikaiju-haido.desc: Attacks all enemies with the power of water.

daikaiju-haidoron.desc: Attacks one enemy with strong water power.

daikaiju-gigahaido.desc: Attacks all enemies with powerful water power.

daikaiju-snoma.note: It is a snow and icicle spell, but RPG Data Library classifies it as Water element.

daikaiju-snoraima.desc: Attacks all enemies with snow stronger than Sunōma.
daikaiju-snoraima.note: Classified as Water element in RPG Data Library.

daikaiju-aishikuru.note: Classified as Water element in RPG Data Library.

daikaiju-aishikuruzado.desc: Attacks all enemies with icicles stronger than Aishikuru.
daikaiju-aishikuruzado.note: Classified as Water element in RPG Data Library.

daikaiju-biga.desc: Attacks enemies with the power of lightning.
daikaiju-biga.note: The target differs by source: "a single target" or "all enemies."

daikaiju-bibigan.desc: A lightning attack stronger than Biga.
daikaiju-bibigan.note: The target differs by source: "a single target" or "all enemies."

daikaiju-thunderspear.desc: A weather magic that attacks one enemy with a spear of lightning.

daikaiju-thunderburst.desc: A lightning weather magic stronger than Sandāsupia.

daikaiju-aircutter.desc: A weather magic that attacks all enemies with blades of wind.

daikaiju-airblade.desc: A wind weather magic stronger than Eakattā.

daikaiju-tornado.desc: A weather magic that attacks all enemies with a tornado.
daikaiju-tornado.note: Users follow RRPG and Grimoire Box (RPG Data Library says Kupikupi can use it too).

daikaiju-gura.desc: Attacks all enemies with the power of earth.

daikaiju-guradon.desc: Attacks all enemies with earth power stronger than Gura.

daikaiju-baku.desc: Attacks one enemy with the power of germs.

daikaiju-bakutero.desc: Attacks all enemies with the power of germs.

daikaiju-gigabaku.desc: Attacks all enemies with powerful germ power.
daikaiju-gigabaku.note: The in-game element is "germ" (菌). RPG Data Library writes it "ギガバグ."

daikaiju-magicarrow.desc: Attacks all enemies with magic arrows.
daikaiju-magicarrow.note: The element follows RPG Data Library's classification.

daikaiju-holysun.desc: A weather magic that attacks all enemies with holy sunlight.
daikaiju-holysun.note: The element follows RPG Data Library's classification.

daikaiju-jueruna.desc: Turns one enemy into a jewel.

daikaiju-danburoku.desc: Lowers the defense of one enemy.
daikaiju-danburoku.note: RPG Data Library writes it "ダンブログ."

daikaiju-betoro.desc: Lowers the speed of all enemies.

daikaiju-pawado.desc: Raises the attack power of one ally.

daikaiju-burokuto.desc: Raises the defense of one ally.

daikaiju-dasshu.note: The target differs by source: "a single target" or "all allies."

daikaiju-bifi.desc: Temporarily raises the level of all allies.

daikaiju-ribasuta.desc: Lets one ally attack in succession.

daikaiju-rimajiku.desc: Places a ward on one ally that reflects magic.

daikaiju-baringa.desc: Reduces the damage one ally takes.

daikaiju-hosupa.desc: Restores the HP of all allies.

daikaiju-hosupita.desc: Fully restores the HP of all allies.

daikaiju-benomun.note: The MP cost is 3 in RPG Data Library and Grimoire Box and 5 in RRPG, and the cost field uses 3.

daikaiju-ekushisuto.desc: Lifts a curse from one ally.

daikaiju-orukyua.desc: Cures all the status ailments of one ally at once.

daikaiju-majikurin.desc: Removes the magic cast on one ally.

daikaiju-furugein.desc: Revives one knocked-out ally with full HP.

daikaiju-warpuru.desc: Moves to a town you have stopped by before.

daikaiju-reddodoragon.desc: Summons a dragon with the power of shells and attacks all enemies with the power of fire.
daikaiju-reddodoragon.note: From the middle of the game onward, shell magic becomes an independent command that everyone can use (RRPG).

daikaiju-aquadoragon.desc: Summons a dragon with the power of shells and attacks all enemies with the power of water.
daikaiju-aquadoragon.note: RPG Data Library lists the elements of Akua and Uindo as swapped, but we followed RRPG's description and the names. From the middle of the game onward, shell magic becomes an independent command that everyone can use (RRPG).

daikaiju-uindodoragon.desc: Summons a dragon with the power of shells and attacks all enemies with the power of wind.
daikaiju-uindodoragon.note: From the middle of the game onward, shell magic becomes an independent command that everyone can use (RRPG).

daikaiju-randodoragon.desc: Summons a dragon with the power of shells and attacks all enemies with the power of earth.
daikaiju-randodoragon.note: From the middle of the game onward, shell magic becomes an independent command that everyone can use (RRPG).

daikaiju-daikairyu.desc: A big non-elemental attack on all enemies that only the protagonist can use.
daikaiju-daikairyu.note: Only the protagonist can use it (RRPG and RPG Data Library).

daikaiju-parabiraizu.desc: Attacks one enemy with lightning, and may paralyze it.
daikaiju-parabiraizu.note: The paralysis effect comes from RRPG's description (RPG Data Library lists damage only).

daikaiju-puresu.desc: Halves the HP of all enemies.
daikaiju-puresu.note: RPG Data Library lists a 75% success rate.

daikaiju-puresshaa.desc: Greatly cuts the HP of all enemies.
daikaiju-puresshaa.note: RPG Data Library says "reduces HP to 1/4" and RRPG says "HP reduced by 1/4." Its line and tier are inferred from how its name and effect line up with Puresu.

daikaiju-bakuteraa.desc: Cuts the HP of all enemies down to a single digit with the power of germs.
daikaiju-bakuteraa.note: RPG Data Library lists a 50% success rate.

daikaiju-biibaku.desc: Greatly lowers the stats of all enemies.
daikaiju-biibaku.note: RPG Data Library lists a 50% stat reduction and a 75% success rate.

daikaiju-enerucheinji.desc: Revives one knocked-out ally with full HP at the cost of the caster's own life.

daikaiju-hiitosutoomu.desc: Attacks all enemies with a storm of heat.

daikaiju-reiniiaroo.desc: Attacks all enemies with arrows of rain.

daikaiju-hoorirein.desc: Attacks all enemies while also curing the status ailments of allies.

daikaiju-furiijinguea.desc: Attacks all enemies with freezing air.
daikaiju-furiijinguea.note: Weather magic. RRPG lists it as Water element.

daikaiju-poizunmisuto.desc: Attacks all enemies with a poisonous mist and poisons them.
daikaiju-poizunmisuto.note: Weather magic. The in-game element is "germ" (RRPG). The poison effect comes from RRPG's description.

daikaiju-sutoreimisuto.desc: Lowers the accuracy of all enemies with a mist.

daikaiju-misutikuraudo.desc: One of the weather magics activates at random.

daikaiju-sanshawaa.desc: Fully restores the HP of all allies.

daikaiju-misutiiheizu.desc: Halves the damage all allies take.

daikaiju-rasutoreinboo.desc: Attacks all enemies and also restores the HP of allies.
daikaiju-rasutoreinboo.note: Tokia learns it in a side story. RPG Data Library classifies it as Light element, and RRPG lists it in its weather magic section.

daikaiju-faiaareo.desc: Summons a beast of fire and deals small Fire damage to all enemies.
daikaiju-faiaareo.note: Pot's summon magic. Fire element. Grimoire Box writes it "ファイヤーレオ."

daikaiju-fiborugu.desc: Summons a beast and deals Water damage to all enemies.

daikaiju-toriton.desc: Summons Triton and deals Water damage to all enemies.

daikaiju-garuuda.desc: Summons Garuda and deals Wind damage to all enemies.

daikaiju-titaan.desc: Summons Titan and deals Earth damage to all enemies.

daikaiju-sandaayuniko.desc: Summons a unicorn and deals Lightning damage to all enemies.
daikaiju-sandaayuniko.note: Pot's summon magic. Lightning element (RRPG). The MP cost is 20 in RPG Data Library and Grimoire Box and 31 in RRPG, and the cost field uses 20.

daikaiju-meduusa.desc: Summons Medusa and turns all enemies to stone.
daikaiju-meduusa.note: Pot's summon magic. RPG Data Library lists a 50% success rate. The MP cost is 25 in RPG Data Library and Grimoire Box and 37 in RRPG, and the cost field uses 25.

daikaiju-vanpaia.desc: Summons a vampire that drains HP from all enemies and heals allies.

daikaiju-gasujaianto.desc: Summons a giant that damages all enemies and keeps dealing damage afterward.

daikaiju-fureadeemon.desc: Summons a demon of flame and deals heavy Fire damage to all enemies.
daikaiju-fureadeemon.note: Pot's summon magic. Fire element (RRPG). RRPG writes it "フレアーデーモン." The MP cost is 40 in RPG Data Library and Grimoire Box and 55 in RRPG, and the cost field uses 40.

daikaiju-biinasu.desc: Summons a goddess and fully restores the HP of all allies.

daikaiju-desu.desc: Summons the Reaper and instantly kills all enemies.
daikaiju-desu.note: Pot's summon magic. RPG Data Library lists a 75% success rate.

daikaiju-kaikousen.desc: Attacks one enemy with a beam of light.
daikaiju-kaikousen.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). Confirmed in only one source. The cost and users are confirmed in only one source.

daikaiju-akuahoiiru.desc: Attacks all enemies with a whirlpool.
daikaiju-akuahoiiru.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). The sources do not state an element, so it was classified by its name.

daikaiju-onara.desc: Lowers the attack power of everyone, enemies and allies alike.
daikaiju-onara.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). RPG Data Library also lists an effect that raises Fire damage. RRPG lists its effect as unknown.

daikaiju-kaenryuu.desc: Attacks all enemies with blazing flames.
daikaiju-kaenryuu.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use).

daikaiju-kamikudaki.desc: Chomps one enemy for heavy damage.
daikaiju-kamikudaki.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). RPG Data Library lists double normal damage.

daikaiju-kamitsuki.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). RPG Data Library lists 1.5 times normal damage.

daikaiju-saiminha.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). Confirmed in only one source. The cost and users are confirmed in only one source.

daikaiju-supaaku.desc: Lowers the accuracy of all enemies.
daikaiju-supaaku.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use).

daikaiju-surooriibaburu.desc: Lowers the speed of all enemies with bubbles.
daikaiju-surooriibaburu.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). Confirmed in only one source. The cost and users are confirmed in only one source.

daikaiju-chouonpa.desc: Attacks all enemies with ultrasonic waves.
daikaiju-chouonpa.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). Confirmed in only one source. The cost and users are confirmed in only one source.

daikaiju-nameru.desc: Licks one enemy. It has no noticeable effect.
daikaiju-nameru.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). RRPG lists it as having no effect.

daikaiju-baburubonbaa.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use).

daikaiju-hpsutoroo.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). Confirmed in only one source.

daikaiju-faiaburesu.desc: Breathes on one enemy to deal damage.
daikaiju-faiaburesu.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). Confirmed in only one source. daikaiju-makousen.desc: Attacks enemies with a suspicious beam.
daikaiju-makousen.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). The target differs by source: "one enemy" or "all enemies."

daikaiju-mashingankikku.desc: Kicks enemies at random three times.
daikaiju-mashingankikku.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use).

daikaiju-rokkusupaiku.desc: Thrusts rock spikes up from the ground to attack all enemies.
daikaiju-rokkusupaiku.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). Confirmed in only one source. daikaiju-ashiddomisuto.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). RRPG lists it as Germ element.

daikaiju-furusapooto.desc: Casts support magic on all allies at once.
daikaiju-furusapooto.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use). RRPG lists it as raising attack, defense and speed and granting consecutive attacks.

daikaiju-chenji.desc: Transforms all allies into the form of one party member.
daikaiju-chenji.note: One of Poyon's learn-by-experience magics (learned by being hit by magic that enemies use).

oni-shinsen.desc: Hōjutsu art. Restores one ally's HP.

oni-senjunoiyashi.desc: Hōjutsu art. Cures one ally's status ailments.

oni-gorai.desc: Hōjutsu art. Attacks with lightning; you choose one enemy or all enemies.
oni-gorai.note: The target can be chosen when casting. Element is inferred from the spell's name.

oni-daichinomamori.desc: Hōjutsu art. Raises one ally's defense.

oni-taishaku.desc: Hōjutsu art. Raises one ally's attack.

oni-rakusuiha.desc: Hōjutsu art. Attacks with water; you choose one enemy or all enemies.
oni-rakusuiha.note: The target can be chosen when casting. Element is inferred from the spell's name.

oni-fusetsuranbu.desc: Hōjutsu art. Attacks; you choose one enemy or all enemies.
oni-fusetsuranbu.note: The target can be chosen when casting. The element could not be confirmed in the sources, so it is set to none.

oni-kaenjigoku.desc: Hōjutsu art. Attacks all enemies with fire.

oni-bakusuiha.desc: A Hōjutsu art that puts all enemies to sleep with a wave of drowsiness.
oni-bakusuiha.note: The Game Boy version shows the name in hiragana, and two sources (gesato and tsubasa) agree on ばくすいは, so it is registered this way. The kanji in novc is 縛水落, but that does not match the reading. It may be a mistake for 縛水破, based on Rakusuiha (落水破) in the same list.

zelda-din-no-honoo.desc: Spreads a dome of fire around Link and damages nearby enemies.
zelda-din-no-honoo.note: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (N64, 1998). One of three spells granted by the Great Fairies, and it uses the magic meter. Scope is left unset because the effect covers the area around Link. The cost comes from sources for Ocarina of Time 3D (3DS): the meter's maximum is 24, or 48 after the magic upgrade. We could not directly confirm the N64 value in Japanese sources.

zelda-farore-no-kaze.desc: Records a point inside a dungeon, then warps back to it later.
zelda-farore-no-kaze.note: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (N64, 1998). One of three spells granted by the Great Fairies, and it uses the magic meter. The cost comes from sources for Ocarina of Time 3D (3DS): the meter's maximum is 24, or 48 after the magic upgrade. We could not directly confirm the N64 value in Japanese sources. The cost is paid when you set the warp point, not when you warp.

zelda-nayru-no-ai.desc: Surrounds Link with a barrier for a while so that he takes no damage.
zelda-nayru-no-ai.note: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (N64, 1998). One of three spells granted by the Great Fairies, and it uses the magic meter. Kind is left unset because it makes Link invulnerable to both physical and magical damage. The cost comes from sources for Ocarina of Time 3D (3DS): the meter's maximum is 24, or 48 after the magic upgrade. We could not directly confirm the N64 value in Japanese sources. The cost is paid when the barrier is raised, and nothing more is spent while the effect lasts (about one minute).
