grandia-keroma.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Water 1. The first Water magic you can learn with a Mana Egg (Siliconera). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-muunya.desc: Puts all enemies to sleep with sweet soap bubbles.
grandia-muunya.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Water 3. The range is all enemies in three Japanese sources, but one enemy in the English-language source (Almar's Guides). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-mikeroma.desc: Restores a little HP to all allies.
grandia-mikeroma.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Water 5. The all-allies version of Keroma (both effects are "restores a little"). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-keromamu.desc: Restores a good amount of HP to one ally.
grandia-keromamu.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Water 8. The upper tier of Keroma (a little to a good amount). The English release uses a different name.

grandia-mikeromamu.desc: Restores a good amount of HP to all allies.
grandia-mikeromamu.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Water 12. The upper tier of Mikeroma (a little to a good amount). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-yomi.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Water 16. The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-mikeromakishimu.desc: Restores a large amount of HP to all allies.
grandia-mikeromakishimu.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Water 20. The upper tier of Mikeromamu (a good amount to a large amount). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-digan.desc: Raises all allies' defense with the power of the earth.
grandia-digan.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Earth 1. The first Earth magic you can learn with a Mana Egg (Siliconera). The English release uses a different name (spelled differently in Almar's Guides). Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-defurosu.desc: Lowers the defense of all enemies.
grandia-defurosu.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Earth 6. The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-guragin.desc: Attacks enemies over a wide area with the energy of the earth.
grandia-guragin.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Earth 3. The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-maguneido.desc: Pins one enemy down with gravity so it cannot move.
grandia-maguneido.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Earth 12. The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-guranjio.desc: Attacks all enemies with a great earthquake.
grandia-guranjio.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Earth 19. The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-raiga.desc: Attacks enemies in range with a discharging ball of lightning.
grandia-raiga.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Fire 5 + Wind 4. Lightning element (Fire + Wind). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-raiden.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Fire 10 + Wind 9. Lightning element (Fire + Wind). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-tenrai.desc: Strikes one enemy with holy lightning.
grandia-tenrai.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Fire 19 + Wind 15. Lightning element (Fire + Wind). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-ryuurai.desc: Attacks all enemies with lightning in the form of a dragon.
grandia-ryuurai.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Fire 21 + Wind 19. Lightning element (Fire + Wind). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-kekkai.desc: Seals in one enemy so it can do nothing for a while.
grandia-kekkai.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Fire 23 + Wind 24. Lightning element (Fire + Wind). Liete only. Japanese sources say it "seals attacks for a fixed time", while an English-language playthrough record (Let's Play Archive) says it completely stops the enemy's movement and deals damage little by little. A Japanese source lists power 450. The reading is not confirmed in sources. The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-shakia.desc: Impales one enemy with a pillar of ice.
grandia-shakia.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Wind 3 + Water 2. Blizzard element (Wind + Water). The English release uses a different name.

grandia-pikin.desc: Chills all enemies, lowering their movement.
grandia-pikin.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Wind 6 + Water 5. Blizzard element (Wind + Water). The English release uses a different name. On the OLD Game Wiki's Feena page there is one unnamed Blizzard Lv1 spell, so Feena may also learn it, but this is unconfirmed.

grandia-korude.desc: Chills one enemy, lowering its speed.
grandia-korude.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Wind 10 + Water 8. Blizzard element (Wind + Water). Magic level is 2 in nJOY and chulip.org and 3 in Himawari Seitai. The English-language source says it lowers Wit. The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-shakiido.desc: Blasts all enemies with diamond dust.
grandia-shakiido.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Wind 10 + Water 12. Blizzard element (Wind + Water). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-fiora.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Wind 8 + Water 10. Blizzard element (Wind + Water). The English release uses the same name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-purizun.desc: Protects one ally so they take no damage for a while.
grandia-purizun.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Wind 20 + Water 23. Blizzard element (Wind + Water). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-kyuuru.desc: Cures one ally's poison with the power of green.
grandia-kyuuru.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Water 3 + Earth 2. Forest element (Water + Earth). The English release uses a different name.

grandia-pozu.desc: Inflicts deadly poison on enemies in a narrow area.
grandia-pozu.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Water 5 + Earth 3. Forest element (Water + Earth). The spelling is ポズ in chulip.org and Himawari Seitai and ボズ in nJOY (the in-game spelling is unconfirmed, and ポズ from the two sources is used). The range is a narrow area of enemies in Japanese sources, but one enemy in the English-language source. The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-sutoramu.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Water 6 + Earth 5. Forest element (Water + Earth). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-kururu.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Water 10 + Earth 10. Forest element (Water + Earth). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-rifuresu.desc: Removes the technique seal from one ally.
grandia-rifuresu.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Water 12 + Earth 10. Forest element (Water + Earth). The English release uses a different name.

grandia-sutaa-shinfonii.desc: Raises all of all allies' stats.
grandia-sutaa-shinfonii.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Water 20 + Earth 20. Forest element (Water + Earth). Liete only. The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-byuune.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Water 13 + Earth 13. Forest element (Water + Earth). The sources differ: MP is 4 in nJOY and chulip.org and 3 in Himawari Seitai (4 is used). The English-language source says it raises Wit. The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-harubeeru.desc: Cures all of one ally's status ailments.
grandia-harubeeru.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Water 19 + Earth 16. Forest element (Water + Earth). The sources differ: nJOY, chulip.org and OLD Game Wiki say MP 5 and one ally, while Himawari Seitai says MP 12 and all allies (MP 5 and one ally are used). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-wao.desc: Breathes fiery spirit into one ally, raising their attack power.
grandia-wao.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Earth 5 + Fire 5. Explosion element (Earth + Fire). The English release uses a different name (spelled differently in Almar's Guides). Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-zunga.desc: Causes an explosion that attacks enemies in a narrow area.
grandia-zunga.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Earth 7 + Fire 6. Explosion element (Earth + Fire). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-zundeo.desc: Spews magma to attack all enemies.
grandia-zundeo.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Earth 10 + Fire 10. Explosion element (Earth + Fire). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-meteo-sutoraiku.desc: Drops a meteor to attack one enemy.
grandia-meteo-sutoraiku.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Earth 15 + Fire 13. Explosion element (Earth + Fire). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-dezun.desc: Causes a huge explosion that attacks all enemies.
grandia-dezun.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Earth 20 + Fire 18. Explosion element (Earth + Fire). The English release uses a different name. Whether Gadwin, Rapp and Liete learn it is confirmed in only one source, chulip.org.

grandia-toki-no-mon.desc: Stops time for everything except the caster.
grandia-toki-no-mon.note: Magic Lv1, required skill Wind 99 + Water 99. Light Wing magic (Feena only). Learned after an event partway through the story. The required skill in the sources is Wind 99 + Water 99. The English-language source (Almar's Guides) lists it in the Blizzard column. The reading is not confirmed in sources. The English release uses a different name.

grandia-seimei-no-ki.desc: Restores all allies to the best possible condition.
grandia-seimei-no-ki.note: Magic Lv2, required skill Water 23 + Earth 22. Light Wing magic (Feena only). Learned after an event partway through the story. The required skill is Water 23 + Earth 22 in Japanese sources and Water 22 + Earth 23 in the English-language source (Forest column). The reading is not confirmed in sources. The English release uses a different name.

grandia-owaru-sekai.desc: Attacks all enemies with a destructive power that returns everything to nothing.
grandia-owaru-sekai.note: Magic Lv3, required skill Fire 27. Light Wing magic (Feena only). Learned after an event partway through the story. The required skill is Fire 27, and the OLD Game Wiki's Feena page (which writes it as おわるせかい) and the English-language source list it in the Fire column. nJOY, chulip.org and Himawari Seitai write it as 終わる世界. The English release uses a different name.
